content.title: Portfolio | Cristian Díaz Vega - Web Developer
content.description: Professional portfolio of Cristian Díaz Vega: Backend, Full Stack projects, and secure, scalable software solutions.

start.title: Web Developer | Node.js & React
start.description: 👋 Hi! I'm Cristian Díaz Vega, an IT Infrastructure Associate Degree graduate and Full Stack Web Developer specialized in the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem. Passionate about software architecture, scalable REST API design, and security. I combine my background in Linux system administration and containerization (Docker/Podman) to build efficient, robust, production-ready applications.

technicalSkills.title: Tech Stack
technicalSkills.description: Technologies and tools I use to build end-to-end software solutions:

items.itemTitle: Strong command of ES6+ for Full Stack development, asynchronous programming, DOM manipulation, and modern architecture with React and Node.js.
Building scalable backend environments, RESTful APIs, gRPC-communicated microservices, and real-time servers.
Design, modeling, and management of relational databases in PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB, optimizing query performance and data integrity.
Solid foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), design patterns, and backend application development with SQL persistence.
Semantic web markup, structured layout, and best practices for accessibility (A11y) and SEO.
Responsive design (Mobile First), modern layouts with Flexbox/Grid, and efficient UI styling.
Developing interactive and scalable SPAs using component-based architecture, Custom Hooks, and state management.
Building secure backend servers and RESTful APIs, implementing custom middleware, modular routing, and authentication.
Creating high-performance websites with minimal load times using Islands Architecture integrated with React.
Agile design and prototyping of responsive and institutional interfaces using pre-compiled components.
Building cross-platform mobile user interfaces, consuming native APIs, and managing visual state.
System administration, permission management, server environment setup, and task automation via Shell Scripting (Bash).
Application containerization, isolated environments creation, and local development orchestration using Docker/Podman Compose.
Distributed version control, branch management, and collaborative workflows.
Repository management, testing integration, and automation via CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.

project.title: Featured Projects
project.description: Selected projects showcasing backend development, architecture, infrastructure, and web applications:

cards.subtitle: Microservices Architecture
cards.text: Distributed backend architecture based on independent microservices built with Node.js and Express. Each service manages its own SQL database and communicates via REST APIs. Locally orchestrated environment using Podman Compose.

cards.subtitle: Real-Time Chat Server
cards.text: Bi-directional instant messaging application powered by Node.js, Express, and Socket.io. Features real-time location sharing, optimized state synchronization in React to reduce perceived latency, and automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions.

cards.subtitle: Secure REST API with PostgreSQL
cards.text: Robust REST API built with Node.js and Express. Features PostgreSQL persistence, JWT authentication, HTTPS encryption, Helmet security headers, and interactive Swagger documentation.

cards.subtitle: Bash Automation Scripts
cards.text: A collection of Bash scripts designed for Linux system administration. Automates recurring maintenance tasks, system backups, and environment provisioning.

cards.subtitle: Hybrid Authentication System
cards.text: Full Stack user authentication and session management system. Express-session and MySQL backend with a dynamic React frontend featuring protected routes using React Router DOM.

cards.subtitle: Hotel Management System
cards.text: Desktop application built with Java for managing reservations and guests. Implements relational database persistence using MySQL via JDBC.

cards.subtitle: Image Optimizer CLI
cards.text: Command-line tool built with Node.js for batch image processing. Leverages Sharp and Imagemin to resize and compress images while preserving high visual quality.

cards.subtitle: Pomodoro Mobile App
cards.text: Productivity-focused mobile application built with React Native. Manages work and break intervals using the Pomodoro Technique.

cards.subtitle: NASA Space Explorer Mobile
cards.text: Mobile app built with React Native consuming NASA's public APIs to display the Astronomy Picture of the Day and space mission details.

cards.subtitle: Calorie Tracker Mobile App
cards.text: Mobile app built with React Native to help users track daily caloric intake and maintain healthy habits.

cards.subtitle: Flappy Bird Game (Phaser + React)
cards.text: 2D web game developed by integrating the Phaser.js game engine into a React UI with custom CSS3 styling.

cards.subtitle: Institutional Portal
cards.text: Interactive institutional website for an educational entity, built with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive layout powered by Bootstrap.

cards.subtitle: Markdown Editor & Previewer
cards.text: Web tool built with React for real-time editing and previewing of Markdown-formatted text.

cards.subtitle: Node Weather CLI
cards.text: Backend command-line app built with Node.js consuming OpenWeatherMap API to display real-time weather forecasts.

cards.subtitle: Task Manager CLI
cards.text: Interactive CLI tool built with Node.js, Readline, and Chalk for managing and persisting daily tasks.

cards.subtitle: Hangman Game in React
cards.text: React implementation of the classic Hangman game, demonstrating complex state management and conditional rendering.

cards.subtitle: React Calculator Web App
cards.text: React web app for basic arithmetic operations, implementing expression evaluation and responsive CSS styling.

cards.subtitle: Text Encryptor Web App
cards.text: Vanilla JavaScript web app for encrypting and decrypting messages using substitution algorithms.

cards.subtitle: Random Quote Generator
cards.text: SPA built with React and Vite that displays random inspirational quotes and dynamically alters visual themes.

cards.subtitle: Rest Timer Web App
cards.text: Timer application built with React to optimize active breaks and work routines.

cards.subtitle: Hangman Game (Vanilla JS)
cards.text: Logic game built with pure HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript, showcasing event handling and interactive DOM manipulation.
